Member-only story Artificial Intelligence Product Management Claude Ai Product Strategy Anthropic Claude Why Claude Stopped Being a Chatbot In September, Anthropic took three separate Claude products and folded them back into one conversation. It’s one of the most interesting product decisions of the year. Mohit Aggarwal 7 min read · Oct 13, 2026 -- 1 Listen Share Press enter or click to view image in full size A few weeks ago I counted the tabs I had open for one small job. I was putting together a short deck to explain my open-source skills library to a meetup group. Claude was open in one tab, helping me work out what to say. Cowork was open in another, because that’s where I’d been pulling notes together from a folder. Claude Design was in a third, for the slides themselves. And Google Slides was in a fourth, because I still wasn’t sure where the finished thing was supposed to live. Four tabs. Three of them were Claude. I remember thinking: this is a bit silly, isn’t it? It’s the same assistant. Why am I the one carrying information between its different rooms? It turns out Anthropic was thinking the same thing. On 16 September 2026, it announced Claude Docs and Claude Slides, and quietly did something bigger: it started merging its separate products back into a single Claude. The company calls it “One Claude”. And as a product manager, I think it’s one of the most revealing decisions any AI company has made… -- -- 1 Written by Mohit Aggarwal 1.5K followers · 147 following AI product builder, MBA, IITian.
